the Pokémon Race}} '''Mt. Spirit''' (Japanese: '''神山''' ''Mt. {{wp|Kami}}'') is a location exclusive to [[The Electric Tale of Pikachu]] {{pkmn|manga}}. It is a tall mountain on the outskirts of [[Fuchsia City]]. The flag on its peak is the finishing point for the [[Fuchsia Free-For-All Race]]. Mt. Spirit is covered in steep cliffs and is blanketed in thick fog all year round, making traversing it dangerous. ==Related articles== {{Mangalocations}} {{DoubleProjectTag|Manga|Locations}} [[Category:Kanto locations]] [[Category:Mountains|Spirit]] [[Category:Electric Tale of Pikachu]] [[de:Shin-zan]] [[it:Mt.
